selection_policy.eligibility: exact Core-locked rows with complete identities and verified YAML hashes; keep only hardness-eligible rows: open-headroom, all-models-zero with open oracle, Hy3-strict [5, 35), unresolved Hy3-zero, greedy-strong/LLM-lag, or discriminative rows with min=0 and mean<40; drop saturated/ceiling, unrankable dead cells, LLM-easy means>=50, Hy3>=50 unless models still lag, score plateaus, and horizon>=600 unless keep-headroom still lags. Families or domains with no hard row are omitted; unique-family hostages are not restored
selection_policy.inclusion: coverage-close the hardness-eligible pool, complete eligible backend/family/difficulty/horizon strata, hit domain floors from the hard pool, keep open-headroom / greedy-peer-with-LLM-lag cells, then enrich Hy3-hard rows under family caps
selection_policy.budget_interpretation: upper bound limits quality enrichment and never removes required eligible coverage, stratum completion, or domain floors; lower bound is not a size target; Lite may omit a Core family or domain that has no hardness-eligible row
selection_policy.quality_ranking: CPU wait/greedy/oracle 0.17, four-model Lite 0.17, and Hy3 Full ok scores; hardness-eligible rows rank above saturated, dead, plateau, LLM-easy, or Hy3-easy cells
selection_policy.scope: hardness-filtered development coverage, not a statistical sample or Full leaderboard denominator

features: U.S. DOT FHWA Next Generation Simulation (NGSIM) US-101 Vehicle Trajectories and Supporting Data
